hook: You could be breaking the law if your Connecticut job ad lacks a salary range starting Oct 1, 2026.

sections.voiceover: You could be breaking the law if your Connecticut job ad lacks a salary range starting Oct 1, 2026.
How many states, plus Washington, D.C., now require salary‑range postings in job ads as of October 2026?
But the catch is, even outside Connecticut, fourteen states and Washington, D.C. already enforce salary‑range posting rules.
Fourteen states and D.C. now demand salary‑range postings in ads. The IRS now lets employers exclude up to $7,500 of dependent‑care benefits from taxable wages on 2026 W‑2s.
Check your job posting by Oct 1, 2026 to ensure salary ranges are listed, or risk fines.
